text:
ravi: Quick heads-up: overnight planned failover rehearsal for europe-north (00:30-01:00 UTC). Purpose: validate cross-region failback and rehearse operator steps. No scheduled API downtime but expect short p99 spikes and occasional 502s. :rotating_light:

zoe: Blast radius? will this touch model-serving pools or just control plane routing?

ravi: Only routing + control-plane failover hooks. Model-serving stays up (no GPU restarts). We will toggle route priorities and exercise the fallback to regional replica.

henry: Can we apply a temporary SLO slice to avoid automated mitigation? suggest p99 token from 900ms -> 2000ms for 00:25-01:05 UTC.

ravi: Agreed. I'll file the SLO change and set auto-revert at 01:05. ops runbook updated with rollback steps.

sre-bot: Maintenance ticket created: failover-rehearsal-eun-3129991111. Oncall ack required 15m prior.

oncall-bg: Acked. I'll stay in channel and watch the canaries. Please post the canary link.

ravi: Canary link: https://synthetics.internal/canary/failover-eun. We'll run two 5m canaries before and after the switch.

zoe: Also adding a temporary 20% diversion of non-critical traffic to the secondary route during the window. Limits customer impact.

henry: Runbook snippet for rollback:
```
# cancel failover job
kubectl -n controlplane delete job failover-test-3129991111
# restore route priorities
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/routes/prioritize -d '{"region":"eun","priority":"primary"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $CTRL"
```
ravi: Post-mortem criteria: open postmortem if sustained error rate >1% for >10m or failover duration >3m. Otherwise note in maintenance log.

oncall-bg: I'll alert if canary shows >5s p95 or any downstream 502 trends.

ravi: Thanks all. I'll ping at 15m, 5m, and at start. Closing unless new blockers.
